# Visual Assets

This plugin groups related workflows under one installation. Open the matching
contract before acting; do not answer from this index alone.

- [Logo Generator](../../references/modules/logo-generator.md)
  Develop logos, product marks, wordmarks, character marks, and identity systems from a product brief. Use for concept exploration, vector construction, small-size validation, colorways, and identity rules.
- [Photo Abstract Editorial](../../references/modules/photo-abstract-editorial.md)
  Turn one supplied photograph into a restrained vertical editorial diptych. The photograph stays faithful; a sparse abstract panel derives only its spatial, tonal, and color relationships.
- [Scientific Figures](../../references/modules/scientific-figures.md)
  Draw or faithfully reconstruct medical and scientific schematics as editable SVG, using a validated scene model, deterministic vector renderer, and quality checker. Use for pathway and mechanism figures or SciPrism SVG requests; ordinary SVG animation stays with ui-motion.

Load only the supporting references the task needs. The plugin is self-contained;
do not look for a shared AzSkills entry or for other plugins in the catalog.
